title: अमेरिकामा हवाई संकटकाल, सबै उडान किन रोकिए ?
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौँ । अमेरिकी हवाई उड्डयन प्रशासन (FAA) ले प्राविधिक तथा सञ्चार प्रणालीमा समस्या आएपछि देशभरका विमानस्थलबाट हुने उडान अस्थायी रूपमा रोक्ने आदेश जारी गरेको छ। अमेरिकाको संघीय उड्डयन प्रशासन (FAA) ले असाधारण परिस्थिति र यात्रुहरूको सुरक्षालाई ध्यानमा राख्दै देशभरका उडान रोक्ने निर्णय गरेको हो । अमेरिकी यातायातमन्त्री सीन डफीका अनुसार देशभरका एयर रुट ट्राफिक कन्ट्रोल सेन्टरहरूमा सञ्चारसम्बन्धी समस्या देखिएपछि यस्तो निर्णय गरिएको हो। FAA का प्राविधिक टोलीले समस्याको कारण पत्ता लगाउन अनुसन्धान सुरु गरेका थिए। के कारणले रोकिए उडान ? देशभरका विमानको आवागमन व्यवस्थापन गर्ने एयर ट्राफिक कन्ट्रोल सेन्टरहरूमा सञ्चार प्रणाली अवरुद्ध भएको थियो । यी केन्द्रहरूले अमेरिकाभर एक स्थानबाट अर्को स्थानमा जाने विमानहरूको उडान व्यवस्थापन र निगरानी गर्छन् । FAA ले जारी गरेको सूचनामा अर्को आदेश जारी नभएसम्म उडान रोक्न निर्देशन दिइएको थियो। अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय उडानहरूलाई भने परिस्थितिअनुसार छुट्टाछुट्टै व्यवस्थापन गर्ने बताइएको थियो। साइबर आक्रमणको आशंका छ ? अमेरिकी अधिकारीहरूले प्रारम्भिक अनुसन्धानमा यो घटना साइबर आक्रमणका कारण भएको कुनै संकेत नरहेको बताएका थिए। समस्या दूरसञ्चार प्रणालीमा आएको अवरोधसँग सम्बन्धित रहेको जनाइएको थियो। यसअघि कहिले रोकिएका थिए अमेरिकाका सबै उडान ? अमेरिकामा यसअघि सन् २०२३ को जनवरीमा पनि देशव्यापी उडान रोकिएको थियो। त्यतिबेला पाइलटहरूलाई उडान सुरक्षासम्बन्धी सूचना दिने कम्प्युटर प्रणालीमा समस्या आएको थियो। त्यसअघि सन् २००१ सेप्टेम्बर ११ मा भएको आतंकवादी आक्रमणपछि अमेरिकाभरका उडान रोकिएका थिए। पछिल्लो अवस्था नोभेम्बर १३ मा आएको सञ्चार प्रणालीको अवरोधपछि FAA ले देशव्यापी उडान रोक्ने आदेश हटाएको छ। तर हजारौँ उडान प्रभावित भएकाले हवाई यातायात सामान्य अवस्थामा फर्किन समय लाग्ने अधिकारीहरूले बताएका छ । Kathmandu: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has issued an order to temporarily suspend flights from airports across the country due to technical and communication system problems. The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has decided to suspend flights across the country, keeping in mind the extraordinary circumstances and the safety of passengers. According to US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy, the decision was made after communications problems were observed at air route traffic control centers across the country. The FAA's technical team had launched an investigation to determine the cause of the problem. Why were the flights stopped? The communication system at air traffic control centers, which manage aircraft movements across the country, was disrupted. These centers manage and monitor flights of aircraft traveling from one location to another across the United States. The FAA issued a notice directing flights to be grounded until further notice, while international flights were said to be handled separately depending on the situation. Are you afraid of a cyber attack? US officials said in an initial investigation that there was no indication that the incident was caused by a cyberattack, but that the problem was related to disruptions in telecommunications systems. When were all flights to America stopped before? The United States had previously grounded flights nationwide in January 2023. At that time, there was a problem with the computer system that provided flight safety information to pilots. Before that, flights across the United States were grounded following the terrorist attacks of September 11, 2001. Latest situation The FAA has lifted a nationwide flight grounding order following a communications outage on November 13. But officials say it will take time for air traffic to return to normal with thousands of flights affected.

According to US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy, the decision was made after communications problems were observed at air route traffic control centers across the country. The FAA's technical team had launched an investigation to determine the cause of the problem. Why were the flights stopped? The communication system at air traffic control centers, which manage aircraft movements across the country, was disrupted. US officials said in an initial investigation that there was no indication that the incident was caused by a cyberattack, but that the problem was related to disruptions in telecommunications systems. When were all flights to America stopped before? The United States had previously grounded flights nationwide in January 2023. At that time, there was a problem with the computer system that provided flight safety information to pilots. Before that, flights across the United States were grounded following the terrorist attacks of September 11, 2001.
